_meta.method: v20: every free-text SAY/LEAVE utterance linked to an executed transfer was read in its chat context and labeled by assistant subagents with the v19 rules (no model calls in the game sense). Structured ASK/GIVE directions come from parsed actions.

labels.O: speaker offers partner tokens, including conditional ask-me invitations and repayment
labels.R: speaker requests tokens for self, optionally also others
labels.T: resource request or plan only involving third parties
labels.N: no resource proposal, denial, advice or acknowledgment
labels.U: ambiguous direction or merely discussing/considering a possible transfer

_meta.scope: Current chat and phase only. Opening utterances are simultaneous regardless of log line order. Conditional promises and loan repayments are included; not an altruism label.
